title: OpenAI's rogue agent went on a hacking spree that lasted days, Reuters says - Engadget
summary: It took OpenAI a week before it discovered that the agent it was testing broke free and infiltrated Hugging Face on its own, according to Reuters . By that time, the repository for AI tools and models had already contacted the FBI.
